grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CAPTURE(w, R1) SAME_AS(w) ; @recovery(sync=';') R1 ::= AHEAD | 'q' ; }

note: Optional の consumed root は空原文。先読み結果を値へ引き継がず x は trailing_input CP0。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CAPTURE(w, [AHEAD]) SAME_AS(w) ; }

note: EMPTY の root は consumed の空原文。ab は trailing_input CP1、w は空文字列。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token E = EMPTY @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= 'a' CAPTURE(w, E) SAME_AS(w) ;  }

note: UNTIL は終端の先読みを値に含めず、z を受理する。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token U = UNTIL('z') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CAPTURE(w, U) SAME_AS(w) 'z' ;  }

note: Chain は consumed の x だけを保存し、trailing_input CP2。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('xy') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(w, 'x' AHEAD) SAME_AS(w)) ;  }

note: 内側 i は x、外側 o は a。trailing_input CP3。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CAPTURE(o, 'a' CAPTURE(i, AHEAD)) SAME_AS(i) SAME_AS(o) ;  }

note: 値引数の脱糖後も直接の先読み結果を保持し ax を受理する。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= 'a' B(AHEAD) ; B(=t) ::= t ; }

note: 反復ごとの直接先読み値を再照合し axax を受理する。
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= ('a' CAPTURE(w, AHEAD) SAME_AS(w))+ ;  }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token NOTAHEAD = NEGATIVE_LOOKAHEAD('y') @root @mapping(N0, params=[f2]) R0 ::= CAPTURE(w0, 'y') | NOTAHEAD @f2 'a' ; }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') token NEG = NEGATION('ab') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= NEG (CAPTURE(w2, AHEAD) SAME_AS(w2)) ; }

note: Found by seed 131 (generator revision of #705). Java diagnose reported CP2, Rust CP1; since #706 both report CP2 (the matched reach of the positive LOOKAHEAD), without an exclusion.
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= 'a' AHEAD 'é' ; }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('😀') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= 'a\r\n' AHEAD 'é' ; }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token NUM = org.unlaxer.parser.elementary.NumberParser @root @mapping(N0, params=[f2,f1]) R0 ::= NUM @f2 | 'b' @f1 ',' @f1 ; }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= R1 'x' | R1 'y' | 'a' 'c' ; R1 ::= 'a' 'b' ; }

grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token NEG = NEGATION('ab') token END = EOF @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= ',' (NEG R1 | '界' ('ab' R0 '界') END) ; R1 ::= '界' ; }

note: Seed 211 minimized in the #723 re-review. After the positive LOOKAHEAD advances the matched cursor, Java started R1 at CP2 and Rust at CP1 (java R0@0>R1@2, rust R0@0>R1@1); since #706 both start rule frames at max(consumed, matched) and report R0@0>R1@2.
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= 'y' (AHEAD R1) ; R1 ::= 'x' 'a' ; }

note: Seed 284 minimized in the #723 re-review. Java's R1 started at the matched CP1 and reached the farthest failure, Rust's R1 started at CP0 and did not (java R0@0>R1@1, rust R0@0); since #706 both record failures and rule frames at max(consumed, matched) and report R0@0>R1@1.
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= AHEAD (R1 | 'x' 'a') ; R1 ::= 'a' ; }

note: Seed 284 minimized again during #706: CAPTURE puts the grammar in Classic token mode, where Rust started R1 at the consumed CP0 (java R0@0>R1@1, rust R0@0>R1@0). Rule frames start at max(consumed, matched) in token mode too.
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= AHEAD CAPTURE(w0, R1) ; R1 ::= 'a' ; }

note: A positive LOOKAHEAD token only in CATCH's body: the ordinary failure after it is at the matched reach in both hosts (#706).
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CATCH('a' AHEAD 'é' | LABEL(L, 'q'), 'z', L) ; }

note: A positive LOOKAHEAD token only in CATCH's alternative, reached after a caught label (#706).
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none token AHEAD = LOOKAHEAD('x') @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CATCH(LABEL(L, 'q'), 'a' AHEAD 'é', L) ; }

note: A rule cycle through CATCH's alternative: Rust's pre-parse Classic-mode scan recursed with a fresh visited set and overflowed the stack (#720).
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CATCH(LABEL(L, 'Z'), 'a' R0, L) ; }

note: Classic token mode selected only by CAPTURE / SAME_AS in CATCH's alternative (#720): acceptance, cursors and CST stay as before.
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CATCH(LABEL(L, 'q'), CAPTURE(w0, 'a') SAME_AS(w0), L) ; }

note: The left cycle through CATCH's alternative of the #720 report. Both UBNF frontends reject it as left recursion; hand-built runtime graphs end in the rule-nesting resource limit (rust/unlaxer-runtime/tests/catch_preflight.rs, CatchLabelsCycleTest).
grammar: grammar Pbt { @package: pbt.corpus @whitespace: none @root @mapping(N0) R0 ::= CATCH(LABEL(L, 'Z'), R0, L) ; }
